best_available.label: Best available settings for LG 2020–2021
best_available.note: Apply readable controls; keep unavailable controls as explicit manual setup instructions. Acknowledged-only writes are never reported as verified.

evidence.scope: Best-available handling for reviewed legacy platforms; no relaxation of LUT geometry or connection guards.
Recognises OLED65C1PUB and the C1 retail family. Full internal platform remains required for calibration admission.

best_available.label: LG C1 — best available settings
best_available.note: C1 hardware reports cover the five native controls in SDR, HDR10 and Dolby Vision. Probe this TV first; other controls remain usable when readable, otherwise give manual instructions. Accepted writes without readback remain unverified, not universal firmware verification.

evidence.scope: Five native setting candidates may use acknowledged-only success when readback is missing; actual write refusal, readback mismatch, invalid values and changed TV/input remain errors.
Extends only backlight, brightness, color, contrast and energySaving to SDR, HDR10 and Dolby Vision. HLG and other controls receive no acknowledged-only allowance.
